DIV8.HEAD: § 97.505 Element credit.
DIV8.P: (a) The administering VEs must give credit as specified below to an examinee holding any of the following license grants:

TR.TH:
Unexpired (or within the renewal
grace period)

Expired and beyond the renewal
grace period

TR.TD: (2) Advanced; General; or Technician granted before March 21, 1987
(3) Technician Plus; or Technician granted on or after March 21, 1987

DIV8.P: (b) The administering VEs must give credit to an examinee holding a CSCE for each element the CSCE indicates the examinee passed within the previous 365 days.
